status: Hand-written cases approved before rule code. Consuming tests check these inputs. The unseen-document measure is still required before merge.
geometry: Each page line is [x, y, text] in PDF points on a 612 by 792 page, as tests/pdfgen.py reads it.
expectations: The expected text and safety requirements are written by hand. They were not produced by running groundgate.
geometry_assertions: The page lines define PDF inputs. Consuming tests check UTF-8 byte offsets, preserved source words, visible boxes, rotation and CropBox coordinates.
outcome_scope: required_outcomes states the safety floor: a wrong key never admits. The spec conformance vectors define the exact outcome and reason codes. The supported second-column candidate must admit only when all evidence checks pass.
